Title: Generally Available: Durable Functions support for .NET isolated model

Body.Content:
Durable Functions is an extension of Azure Functions that lets you write stateful functions in a serverless compute environment. 

Durable Function’s support for .NET 7.0 running in the isolated worker process is now generally available. Note that this release also supports .NET 6.0 and .NET Framework. 

Additional resources: 

  • Getting started sample
  • Migrating a Durable Functions app from in-process to isolated model
  • Guide for running C# Azure Functions in an isolated process
  • Durable Functions Overview
